mechanism_narrative: A lower level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with higher expected S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity cash flows.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is below 0.5%, 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a monetary tightening cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS (as of t-1mo) is above 4.5%, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 7.0%) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2.0%) signals a recessionary environment that increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 7.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 1.0% in the past 3 months), a decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95.0) signals an imminent recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising > 1.0% in 3 months AND INDPRO < 95.0
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS has risen above 1.0% in the past 3 months and INDPRO < 95.0, 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 500.0 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 500.0, 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of industrial production (INDPRO) is associated with higher equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO (as of t-1mo) is below 95.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) below 350,000 million dollars signals weak consumer demand and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When RSAFS < 350000.0, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is associated with increased equity risk and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE (as of t-1mo) is above 7.0%, 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
